source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Detail who was involved.
3. Document the date and time.
4. Describe the location and environment.
5. Take note of the activity leading up to the incident.
6. Provide a detailed description of the accident itself.
7. Note the injuries sustained.
8. Document any immediate first aid given and the name of the personnel who provided it.
9. Include names of witnesses.
10. Photograph the scene, if possible, and include these images in the report.
11. Mention any protective equipment in use at the time.
12. Detail any equipment or machinery involved in the accident.
13. Identify any factors contributing to the incident, such as poor lighting or missing safety guards.
14. Briefly describe the response actions taken to secure the scene and prevent further accidents.
15. Attach any related documentation, such as safety warnings or prior incident reports relevant to the accident.
16. Include a section for supervisor remarks and comments about how the incident could have been
